;Notes
* <small>{{note|A|A}}: This flight operates via [[Walvis Bay Airport|Walvis Bay]]. However, this carrier does not have [[Fifth freedom traffic rights|rights]] to transport passengers solely between Walvis Bay and Saint Helena.</small>
* <small>{{note|B|B}}: One of two of these flights from [[Hartsfield-Jackson Atlanta International Airport|Atlanta]] continues on to [[Cape Town International Airport|Cape Town]]. However, this carrier does not have [[Fifth freedom traffic rights|rights]] to transport passengers solely between Johannesburg and Cape Town.</small>
* <small>{{note|C|C}}: This flight operates via [[Chileka International Airport|Blantyre]].</small>
* <small>{{note|D|D}}: This flight operates via [[Kenneth Kaunda International Airport|Lusaka]].</small>
* <small>{{note|E|E}}: This flight operates between [[Singapore Changi Airport|Singapore]] and [[Cape Town International Airport|Cape Town]] with a stopover at Johannesburg. However, this carrier does not have [[Fifth freedom traffic rights|rights]] to transport passengers solely between Johannesburg and Cape Town.</small>
* <small>{{note|F|F}}: This flight operates via [[Accra International Airport|Accra]].</small>
* <small>{{note|G|G}}: Two flights originate from [[Maputo International Airport|Maputo]] and [[King Shaka International Airport|Durban]] respectively. However, this carrier does not have [[Fifth freedom traffic rights|rights]] to transport passengers solely between Johannesburg and Maputo/Durban.</small>
